_doc: Cursor Enterprise dashboard policy reference for STRICT tier. Apply in the team dashboard and MDM. This file is documentation for admins, not a client-side config drop-in.
_precedence_note: Team dashboard and MDM override ~/.cursor/permissions.json, sandbox.json, settings.json, and project rules. Users cannot weaken these controls.

run_mode._read_controls_note: WHAT: Team Settings, Security and automation, Read Controls. Workspace asks before agent reads and searches outside the project, and limits sandboxed command reads. WHY (Strict): system can read SSH keys and cloud credentials without asking. User extensions off means only the team Read Allowlist applies. Start that list empty. BREAKS: system, or turning user extensions on, lets a member or a project sandbox.json widen readable paths. This does not apply in Run Everything and does not cover Claude Code or Codex. Requires Cursor 3.23 or later. Do not allowlist ~/.ssh or ~/.aws.
